mentions.name: 3D printed apertures for infrared spectrometer
mentions.description: This project consists of 3D printed apertures for a work infrared spectrometer, designed to reduce issues that cause artifacts in the data and enable higher accuracy measurements, particularly of high index and reflective samples. The apertures appear to be working well, with remaining detector non-equivalence issues addressable via a temperature stabilized detector or strong beam attenuation.
mentions.problem: Issues in the infrared spectrometer cause artifacts in the data, limiting measurement accuracy, particularly for high index and reflective samples.
mentions.source_excerpt: I 3D printed some new apertures for an infrared spectrometer at work to reduce some issues that cause artifacts in the data to enable higher accuracy measurements, particularly of high index and reflective samples. Seems to be working well now.
